comment: Anchor values for resource_model.py. Every entry cites its source. evidence levels: MEASURED_HETZNER = real Retail-1.07/Wine run on ubuntu-4gb-nbg1-2 reported in this repository or a referenced PR branch; DERIVED = arithmetic on measured values; nothing in this file was measured inside the LMArena sandbox.

arch_a_shared_clients.description: Public architecture A: 1x DedicatedServer + 2x SeriousSam.exe with 4 local bot players each, Build04 NullRender, 20 Hz.

arch_b_individual_clients.description: PR #47 architecture B: N independent Retail clients, one bot each, private server, loopback namespace, overlay mounts, private cgroup.
arch_b_individual_clients.redstation_attempt_failure: private admin drain timeout (explicitly NOT proven RAM-caused)

derived.arch_b_fit_check_8_clients_note: linear fit predicts 1960.9 MiB for 8; independent Redstation run peaked at 1725.9 MiB with 7 joined + 1 joining, i.e. fit is conservative within ~12% at 7-8 clients
derived.arch_a_rss_per_bot_note: (188436+188820)/8, shared RSS accounting - NOT a marginal per-bot cost; PSS never measured
derived.source: arithmetic over the MEASURED_HETZNER anchors above
